summary: This video breaks down the top-ranking team composition for Temporal Vortex 1 during Week 1 of Season 9 on the Chinese server. The build pairs an Aura team with a Toxin team to achieve over 4.2 billion damage, outperforming Dauntless before endgame talents and mythic gear are unlocked. The Aura setup features Talethia, Diantha, Lincos, Anneliesis, and a new Season 9 Frost support, while the Toxin setup runs Sleight, Twitch, Serpentemis, Sacredeia, and Child of Chaos. The guide details positioning, gear priorities, and strict 18-second skill rotation timings.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.verdict: Top Aura DPS for early Vortex 1
heroes.note: Built with mixed 2-piece sets for extra HP along with high Crit Damage to maximize output while surviving the boss.

heroes.name: Diantha
heroes.note: Acts as the Witch's Remains supplier, requiring solid Accuracy alongside standard Crit Rate and Crit Damage.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.note: Equipped with the Puppetmaster artifact to boost overall team performance.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Placed in the backline with high stat investment to bolster Aura team output.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Equipped with Puppetmaster and built with Resistance; works at Inspiration 2, though high Inspiration increases consistency.

heroes.name: Sacredeia
heroes.note: Brought primarily for her 30% poison damage vulnerability and Witch's Remains debuff; can be built defensively if survival is an issue.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.note: Built with the Alignment gear set, prioritizing Attack and heavy Accuracy for reliable debuff application.

heroes.name: Sleight
heroes.note: Provides massive team damage scaling with an Alignment set, gaining roughly 40% damage increase from Inspiration 5.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Geared with Alignment sets focusing on Attack, Enlightenment, and minor Accuracy.

teams.note: Team 1 Aura setup (featuring a Season 9 Frost HP-buffer support); uses an 18-second rotation cycle to dish out heavy single-target burst.
Team 2 Toxin setup; runs synchronized 18-second rotations with Alignment sets and Sacredeia applying poison vulnerability.

meta_changes: During Week 1 of Season 9, Aura paired with Toxin outperforms Dauntless because Dauntless heroes require full talent trees and mythic gear to surpass Aura's early baseline damage.
Once level 79 and mythic gear (Dungeon 15+) are unlocked, Dauntless scales massively from 4 billion up to 15+ billion damage.
tips: Combine two 2-piece gear sets in early season progression to secure bonus HP for squishy DPS units before complete sets can be farmed.
Tune skill timers strictly around an 18-second rotation loop to keep debuffs and buffs synchronized with boss cycles.
If Sacredeia struggles to survive in Vortex 1, build Defense and HP on her instead of Attack, as her value comes from the 30% poison vulnerability debuff and Witch's Remains.
